description: Hide ONE field of ONE resource from ONE role — the building block of the field-level permission model. Example: hide 'notes' on contacts from the role 'sachbearbeitung'. There is deliberately no 'visible' state: no rule means visible, so a rule always means the same thing and nobody has to work out whether true or false wins. Pass remove=true to lift a rule again. resource '*' applies to every resource. IMPORTANT: a hidden field is also not filterable, sortable or searchable — otherwise its value could be read off the result count. Read the 'scope' in list_field_permissions before relying on this: the rules do not yet reach every surface.

field.description: Exact column name, e.g. 'notes'. No wildcard — a wildcard here would blind a role, and that is never what someone means by hiding a field.

reason.description: Why. Shows up in the list and in the audit trail.

remove.description: true lifts the rule instead of setting it.

resource.description: Resource whose field is hidden; '*' applies to every resource

role.description: The tenant's own role name, e.g. 'sachbearbeitung'.

name: set_field_permission
